Restrictor or TXV / Charge Addition (Oz) Instructions: 1. Find the column for the model of outdoor unit that is being installed. 2. Find the row for the model of the indoor unit that is being installed. 3. Find the cell in the table in which this row and column meet. In this cell the appropriate orifice / TXV and charge addition for this match are listed. If the text in this cell is BOLD, then a change of orifice is necessary. 4. If a change in restrictor is necessary, then the appropriate restrictor will already be supplied with the outdoor unit. Examples: • For the *SA1BF4M2SN24K / C7B(A,H)M01824(C,U)-B+TXV match the 920668A TXV kit is needed and no additional refrigerant needs to be added (TXV KIT).. • For the *SA1BF4M2SN60K / C7B(A,H)MX60(C,U)-C match the correct TXV is 669686 and no additional refrigerant needs to be added (NO CHANGES NECESSARY).
